name: discovery
description: Discovery before changes: explore the local codebase, run multi-source external research, and reconstruct why a past decision was made from evidence outside the code. Each dispatches a subagent by default so the reading stays out of the main thread, with source tiers, falsification, recency gates and a coverage ledger, and persists EXPLORE.md / RESEARCH.md / INTENT.md handoff artifacts. A research sweep workflow (/discovery:research-sweep) backs deep research with adversarial claim verification.

explore_output.title: Explore reply shape
explore_output.description: Reply shape of /discovery:explore. auto (default): explain when a person asks how something works, else change-prep, including calls from other skills. change-prep: the handoff summary. explain: a walkthrough citing path:line. EXPLORE.md is unchanged. docs/conventions/discovery.yaml overrides this.

research_corroborators.title: Research corroborators per claim
research_corroborators.description: Independent current corroborators /discovery:research needs per accepted claim beside its primary. Default 2. The broad-topic minimum and the single-source exception are unchanged. docs/conventions/discovery.yaml overrides this.

research_recency_active_days.title: Research recency window, active project (days)
research_recency_active_days.description: Recency window /discovery:research applies to a very active project (weekly releases, breaking changes, security-sensitive). Default 14. docs/conventions/discovery.yaml overrides this.

research_recency_standard_days.title: Research recency window, standard tool (days)
research_recency_standard_days.description: Recency window /discovery:research applies to a standard library, tool, CLI or API. Default 30. docs/conventions/discovery.yaml overrides this.

research_recency_guide_days.title: Research recency window, architecture guide (days)
research_recency_guide_days.description: Recency window /discovery:research applies to a tool- or vendor-specific architecture guide. Default 90. docs/conventions/discovery.yaml overrides this.

medium.title: Preferred delivery medium
medium.description: Where the /discovery:blindspot view goes. auto (default): a local file. terminal: no page; file: a local file; artifact: a private Artifact; hosted = artifact. A terminal or file value in any rendered-views setting wins over this option.
